column3: Note: The power adapter supports the four Sideband signals, hardware-strapped per Row 3. This
strapping corresponds to the “151 – 300 W” power level PCIe CEM 5.0 specification (shown in
Row 3). As a result, it supports only a 310 W TGP for the H100 PCIe card. To support a TGP of 350
W, a power adapter or cable strapped as in Row 1 or Row 2 should be used.
